lines.text: Power to the Ark was quickly restored once the battle ended,
albeit not in certain areas. The crystals that had burst up through the ground caused extensive structural damage.
However, even those areas are expected to receive power again soon.
The exact number of casualties remains unknown.
... It is said to be potentially the worst disaster the Ark has ever suffered.
As for Sixo, the one responsible for all of this...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: After examining the remains of Endless's body,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I was able to determine that Sixo escaped.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: In other words, she survived.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You say that as though it's not a big deal.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: After all the damage she's caused, shouldn't we be doing everything we can to catch her?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Pursuing her is currently not possible. Her final destination is likely to be the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, I have determined that only her main program was transferred, and that she lost most of her other functions.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She will require decades of learning to return to her previous state.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hmm... Still, shouldn't we finish her for good?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: There is no need.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That is a concern for the distant future, by which time humanity will already...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Correction: since this is a matter for the distant future, responding now would be a waste of resources.
... What were you about to say?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: It is of no importance.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What did she even want in the end...?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: There is no way to know.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Sixo was originally utilized as a means to strengthen justice within the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She likely only ever learned how to fortify justice through acts of evil, and thereby resolved to commit ever greater atrocities.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Presumably, this learning culminated in her attempt to seize control of me and bring down the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Her desire for Endless's body was likely for the same reason.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Physical force is essential for committing evil. Greater physical force leads to greater effectiveness.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: This is evidenced by Sixo's decision when the blackout started. She could have retreated and tried again later, but she chose not to.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: There's something I still don't really get, though.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: She used herself as a power source at the end there to wreck the Ark, right?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: But if she had her eyes on Enikk's position, that means she wanted to rule the Ark.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Why destroy the thing you're trying to rule?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: She was likely trying to restore power to the Ark to force my hand, and then seize control of me while I was attempting to contain the situation.
I recall the words Endless spoke before her body was swallowed by crystal.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I will reduce everything to ruin.
I see it differently.
I think she just wanted to ruin the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: But... why?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: That doesn't benefit her at all.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You think she just got desperate and decided to take everything down with her?
Would it be too much of a stretch to say... maybe she just felt like it?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: There is some logic to that.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Perhaps her only goal was to destroy as much as she could for no particular reason.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That kind of senseless malice...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: ... may have been something she learned from humanity.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Human nature has very clear strengths and weaknesses.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The Ark suffered severe damage because of the monster it created.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I hope this incident will become a learning opportunity for the people here to realize the danger of what they possess.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, I am not thrilled about the fact that I would be the first thing they dispose of if they really take that lesson to heart.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow, you can make jokes now?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Thank you for saving the Ark in its time of crisis.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Formulating this as a solo operation for the Commando Unit appears to have been the correct decision.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Granted, Dorothy's intervention wasn't exactly expected.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Did you reach out to her?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No, I said nothing to the Pilgrim Dorothy.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: She must be up to something.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Isn't it kinda rude to question someone who just helped us out?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hm... Yeah, you're right. She probably didn't want anyone to die, either.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Let's go thank her.
Yeah, I've got something I want to tell her anyway.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Well done, all of you.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: We will meet again soon.
We will...?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Correction: we will meet again at some point.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You don't have to thank me.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I only did what I had to.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You seem really interested in me.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah, because we're friends.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Huh? Since when are you two friends?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wait, what does that make us then?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We're friends too, of course. A friend of a friend is a friend, right?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Come to think of it, we've actually known each other for a long time now, huh?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Nice to see you, my good friend Dorothy!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hey! It's my friend Dorothy!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Please leave.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, come on! Is that how you treat your friends?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Question.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What made you try so hard to win the humans over?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Did I?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes, it was quite the impressive performance.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And here I thought you despised the Ark, hehe.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have you changed your mind?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah. I've forgiven everyone.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You should do the same.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I didn't realize what they did to you was so easily forgivable.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It wasn't easy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I just mean that for me, it would be impossible.
Why not take it up with the Ark officially?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Take what up...?
You know, about how you were used and betrayed.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How... how do you know that?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We met Snow White.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She told us everything.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I never knew she could be so talkative.
I don't know what your plan is,
but the most urgent issue we're facing right now is the Queen.
Scarlet and Rapunzel can be revived.
You should join us as...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'll handle my own affairs. Please just stay out of it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What are you planning on doing? You don't have any allies left.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're all alone.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Enough!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm telling you to leave me alone! Please... Okay?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow... I haven't seen Dorothy shout like that in a long time.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: She's cornered.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I'm sorry. I did not mean to raise my voice.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: While I appreciate your concern, I'm asking you to stop.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Rapi, don't say anything more.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... All right.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But I still remember the promise I made back then.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If you ever walk down the wrong path, I will stop you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: So don't go down the wrong path.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Let's go, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... See you around.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Take care, Dorothy. My friend.
... Dorothy, if you wait any longer, it may be too late.
I hope you understand that.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Superbe! Magnifique!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Anis, ma chérie! You shone with such splendeur!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I was so overcome, I shed tears de joie!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Uh, so... did you figure out what the expansive armament actually does?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I've carefully analysé your data de combat.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: The true fonction of the expansive armament Star is le contrôle de l'énergie.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Not merely of laser weapons, non. It can contrôler everything that qualifié d'énergie.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: En général, you can use it to accumuler de l'énergie and then release it in one shot, like the Entertainment Punch.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: However, if you absorbez a lot of énergie,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: it may assume la forme de clothing, as in Starlight Mode.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Starlight... Mode?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui, I gave it that name. Is it not magnifique?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Uh... Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: While it is only temporaire,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: you are, for a moment, able to reproduire the power of the légendaire Nikke, Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What?! Wait, what's Liliweiss got to do with all this?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh, you don't know?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Pretty could have been the next Liliweiss,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: so powerful was the body she possédait.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And since the expanded weapon was created with that body, it was probable made to recréer that power.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... You don't actually know that much about it, do you?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I must admit, non.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It took me quite a long time to décider I should utiliser it.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: To be honest, just looking at it was difficile pour moi.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: And here I thought you were just trying to keep it a secret as part of your whole "entertainment" bit.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Non. I do not pursue entertainment at the détriment of human life.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Anyway!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I've heard une Nikke existe somewhere with a similaire ability to contrôler l'énergie... though I do not know les détails.
... Guillotine.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Okay... so what about the lights and speakers?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Those are for entertainment.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You literally just said you don't place entertainment above people's lives.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Do not misunderstand.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Those are to guarantee that in any circonstance people can see you and hear your voix.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: That way, even in les moments de great desperation, they will not lose hope.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It is a weapon that embodies my personal philosophie.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I get it now. Thanks.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: No, Anis.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: C'est moi who must thank you.
